title: Split web Nostr client module into focused components

observed_behavior.before: web/src/lib/nostr/client.js contained validation, kind constants, tag/content helpers, replaceable logic, assistant parsing, runtime/soul/repository helpers, relay config, singleton client creation, and fetch/subscribe helpers in one 1369-line module. web/src/lib/nostr/pool.js contained the SimplePool wrapper in one 467-line module.
evidence: git diff shows client.js reduced to a compatibility re-export layer
git diff shows pool.js reduced to a public factory/error re-export layer

intended_behavior.summary: Nostr browser client helpers are organized by responsibility while preserving existing imports from $lib/nostr/client.js and event-driven SimplePool behavior.
intended_behavior.compatibility: Existing import paths continue to resolve through client.js -> index.js re-exports. No controlplane.svelte.js, +layout.svelte, or system.svelte.js edits are part of this feature.

included: Split client.js helpers into focused modules
Split pool.js internals into focused modules to keep touched pool wrapper files under 200 lines
Preserve Nostr validation, EOSE query completion, AUTH/CLOSED/OK handling, dedupe, and replaceable semantics

pre-existing oversized nip07.js, nip46.js, and encrypted-controlplane.js are tracked by bahia-kw04
